audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed and, for the mirror, a cooldowns field with no number: dosFull[1].d was verbatim tradeGood and dontsFull[2].d was verbatim tradeBad, so each title promised one thing and its body explained another.
audit.why: Detected by tools/matchup-lint.js. Real cooldowns and ranges are in champ-data/_kits/ and change what the player actually does.
audit.corrected: Each body rewritten to its own title using kit cooldowns and ranges.

edits.before: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight: matchup-defining — His reposition and escape — he is a stationary battery while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Astral Flight has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight: matchup-defining — 22s at rank 1, and it is his only reposition; he is a stationary battery while it is down. - Your W is the same 22s, so spend it second, never first. - Falling Star is 120s: the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: W-flyby: fly a lateral arc, drag Q across Aurelion Sol for two seconds of burn + stacks, and land outside his answer range — repeat forever from one item.
edits.after: Breath of Light is a 750 channel for him too — when he commits to beaming the wave, drag yours across him. Both of you bank stardust; only one is standing still.

edits.before: Channelling Q face-to-face inside his engage range with W down — every champion that touches you wins that exchange pre-items.
edits.after: Falling Star is 120s on both sides at 6 — throw first and you simply eat his. Hold yours until his is spent; then it is not a coin flip.

notes: Mirror matchup (Aurelion Sol vs Aurelion Sol). breakdown.cooldowns carried no digit at all — the one field that exists to hold cooldown numbers — and both dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles. Numbers are from champ-data/_kits/aurelionsol.json: Q Breath of Light 3s / 750, W Astral Flight 22/20.5/19/17.5/16s, E Singularity 12s, R Falling Star 120/110/100s / 1250. Not verified and therefore not asserted: whether Falling Star's stun can be Flash-buffered, and whether Astral Flight can be interrupted mid-flight by the mirror's own stun — needsResearch is empty in the kit, which means unknown, not no.
